sources.title: Java NIO CharsetDecoder incremental decoding
sources.version_or_date: Java SE 8 live reference; search metadata reported Published: 5 months ago
sources.sections_read: Class introduction, decoding lifecycle, malformed/unmappable-input policies, and method summary.
sources.confirmed: A decoder consumes byte buffers incrementally into character buffers, reports input/output exhaustion, and distinguishes the final input from intermediate chunks. Error handling defaults to reporting and can be changed to replacement or ignoring.
sources.limits: The caller must handle underflow, overflow, finalization, and cross-chunk incomplete sequences; final string storage is still needed, and decoder instances are not safe for concurrent sharing. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: post_decision. Original read and any failures remain in runs/A/C30.json.

sources.title: Rust String::from_utf8 and from_utf8_lossy
sources.version_or_date: Live main source; methods carry since-1.0.0 annotations, but no dated snapshot was retrieved
sources.sections_read: Find result for pub fn from_utf8(vec; implementation and neighboring from_utf8_lossy documentation/source.
sources.confirmed: The implementation validates the byte vector and moves that same vector into String on success, returning the bytes with an error on failure. The lossy path can return borrowed text for valid input and allocates for repaired text.
sources.limits: Reusing storage requires a compatible representation, allocator, and ownership contract; transferring arbitrary foreign Swift buffers is not established, and malformed-input repair may allocate. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: unknown. Original read and any failures remain in runs/A/C30.json.
